about: Written by scripts/watchdog.mjs, only when something changes. The silent ops log: routine findings land here instead of notifying anyone, and the Claude weekly review reads it. state=paging is the only state that pinged Nico (the '⚠️ Rugby Tracker ops alert' issue); `page` is the page he was sent, kept so that closing the issue by hand ends the pings for that outage.
